description: BEMServer is a modular building energy management platform. Its current core repository supplies shared functions for a Python API and web interface, with separate packages in the same organisation for each component. It stores monitored building descriptions, sensor time series and events, and supports performance indicators or alerts. Inputs are building hierarchies, campaign metadata, sensor readings and CSV imports; outputs are organised time series, events and API responses for analysis. Coverage follows installed building campaigns, which may span multiple sites and have open-ended dates. The current code is free under MIT terms. A limitation is that the core module alone is not a complete deployment: the API, UI and database setup are separate. Access to a deployed campaign is permission-controlled, but no account is needed to inspect the public source. BEMServer can prepare and check operational inputs for building-energy simulation. The older HIT2GAP repository explicitly says it was abandoned during a refactor. The current user guide was read; no building data was connected.
